title: Compute each estimate
text: With one rectangle of width $$1$$, the left estimate is $$1f{\left(0\right)}=0$$ and the right estimate is $$1f{\left(1\right)}=1$$.

title: Average
text: The average is $$\frac{0+1}{2}=\frac{1}{2}$$, which equals the exact value of the integral, since the area is a triangle with base $$1$$ and height $$1$$.
